title: The integral point completion commutes with scalar extension
statement: For a finite-field datum D, primes l!=p, finite extensions E,L/Q_l and an embedding i:E->L, let I_E,I_L and C_E,C_L be integral point tensor comparisons with their canonical completion maps [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-models]. Define the scalar square as the equality on every good pair of complexes, every homogeneous pair of sections x,y and every two target coefficients a,b: completion after scalar extension of the two tensors equals the recorded scalarTensorChain applied to the scalar extension, with coefficient ab, of completion of x tensor y. Use the actual good-complex scalar functor and the lifted integral coefficients [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
